an4.103:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me kumbhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.103:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti pihito?
an4.103:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghātipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:2.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.103:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti pihito,
an4.103:2.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho tuccho pihito,
an4.103:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti vivaṭo?
an4.103:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantam . . . saṅghātipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:3.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.103:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti vivaṭo,
an4.103:3.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho pūro vivaṭo,
an4.103:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti vivaṭo?
an4.103:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . saṅghātipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:4.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.103:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti vivaṭo,
an4.103:4.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho tuccho vivaṭo,
an4.103:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti pihito?
an4.103:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . saṅghātipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:5.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.103:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti pihito,
an4.103:5.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave bhikkhave kumbho pūro pihito
an4.103:5.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro kumbhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 104.
